text.title: Grocery delivery, Russia, 2026–2028
text.p: courier rules: from 1 March 2026 couriers need a registered contract; source: ministry notice, 14 January 2026
text.e: real incomes up 3% in 2026; key rate 14% to 13% by September 2026 (central bank data)
text.s: 58% of Moscow households order food online at least once a month (survey, May 2026)
text.t: courier route app updated in Q2 2026; personal data rules for orders tightened in 2026
text.env: packaging fee for plastic bags from 2027; not yet in our plans
text.l: consumer protection on refunds; licence for alcohol delivery needed
text.threats: courier costs rise with the new contract rules; the alcohol licence delays the launch
text.opportunities: more households order online; the rate cut lowers the loan cost for the courier fleet
text.decision: start the courier contract change in Q4; apply for the alcohol licence in Q1 2027; revisit when the key rate passes 12%
